program.title: BEng in Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-5, 4-7, 3-4, 1-3).

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. COMP block, CHEM/PHYS block, MATH block, IEDA 4901/4960, ECON 2103/2113, SENG introduction), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.

The Financial Engineering Option requires a CGA of 3.0 or above to enroll, and the Research Option is optional ('Students may opt to graduate with or without an option'); the option credits (15 in total) are included in the calculated total, but a student graduating without an option would not take them.
Remarks in the PDF note that COMP 1022P, IEDA 3180, IEDA 3901, MATH 1012 and RMBI 4210 were last offered in earlier years and subsequently deleted; they are kept in the lists as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 IEEM (4Y) (2024-25 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2024-25 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2024-25 per the intake year.
